summary: Stefani was one of three supervisors who voted NO on the SF Board's 8-3 resolution calling for an immediate and sustained ceasefire in Gaza.
quote: The no votes were from Supervisors Catherine Stefani, Matt Dorsey and Rafael Mandelman.

summary: Stefani spoke in committee calling out the sexual violence Israeli women suffered during the Oct. 7 Hamas attack, drawing jeers from the public.
quote: Members of the public jeered at Supervisor Catherine Stefani as she called out the sexual violence Israeli women suffered during the Oct. 7 attack.

summary: JCRC, ADL, and AJC named Stefani among the three supervisors who opposed the Gaza ceasefire resolution, framing their stance as protecting Jewish community safety.
quote: The three Supervisors who opposed the resolution, Matt Dorsey, Catherine Stefani, and Rafael Mandelman, understand this clearly.

summary: Stefani voted against the SF ceasefire resolution, arguing a ceasefire requires Hamas surrender/removal and hostage return.
quote: You cannot call for a ceasefire without calling for the surrender and removal of Hamas and the return of all hostages.
